title: Maximum Probability Path
description: An undirected graph has `n` vertices. Each edge `edges[i] = [u,v]` succeeds with probability `succProb[i]`. The probability of a path is the product of its edge probabilities. Return the maximum probability of reaching `end` from `start`, or 0 if no path exists. Input: `n`, `edges`, `succProb`, `start`, `end`. Output: the maximum probability.
hints: Represent each edge as a transition whose cost matches the route rule.
Keep the best distance for each required state and ignore stale priority-queue entries.
